newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends higher on exporter negotiations.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends higher on exporter negotiations.

text.p: The won closed higher on Thursday on exporter deals and dollar inflows for stock investment, dealers said.
The won ended at a day high of 890.50, compared with Wednesday's closing of 890.90. After opening at a low of 891.20.
Dealers said they were losing their confidence that 890 level would be supported, given anticipated dollar supply.
"Won's appreciation is quite likely," said a dealer.
Monday's mid-rate is expected to be pegged at 890.90 against 891.00 today. The market will close on Friday for a holiday.
